subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: Rolling into the tree on the island in the southeast of Zora's Fountain reveals a Gold Skulltula that yields a token when killed.

evidence.quote: swim to the island in the very southeast part of the Fountain.  Roll into the tree to find a Gold Skulltula.  Kill it and take it's token.

subject: Great Fairy's Fountain
text: Dropping a bomb between two boulders against the wall reveals a cave leading to the Great Fairy's Fountain.

evidence.quote: Drop a bomb between the two boulders against the wall, and the wall will explode open revealing a massive cave opening.  Go through the cave to find your third Great Fairy's Fountain.

subject: Farore's Wind
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce emblem summons the Great Fairy, who grants Farore's Wind.

evidence.quote: Run forward to the fountain, stand on the Triforce emblem and play Zelda's Lullaby to make the Dominatrix appear.  This time, you'll get Farore's Wind, a spell which lets you set checkpoints in Dungeons.

subject: Jabu-Jabu's Belly
text: Offering a bottled fish while standing in front of Jabu Jabu's mouth causes him to inhale Link into Jabu-Jabu's Belly.

evidence.quote: Go to the west side of the area, and climb up onto the altar in front of Jabu Jabu.  Stand directly in front of his mouth, and use the Fish you captured in the Bottle.  Jabu Jabu will inhale you right along with the Fish.

subject: Parasitic Tentacles
text: Parasitic tentacles blocking various areas of Jabu-Jabu's Belly must be destroyed to reach the elevator to the boss chamber.

evidence.quote: In the dungeon, players must try to activate an elevator in Jabu-Jabu's throat, which leads to the boss' chamber.  This is easier said then done, however, as several areas of Jabu-Jabu's Belly are blocked by parasitic tentacles, which must be destroyed first.

subject: Octorok
text: In the entrance room, Octoroks can be defeated using the Slingshot, and Shaboms can be defeated with Deku Nuts.

evidence.quote: Run forward a few feet, and a pair of Octoroks will appear on the left and right.  Kill them with your Slingshot, then use Deku Nuts to kill the Shaboms (the floating bubble enemies).

subject: Entrance Ceiling Switch
text: Shooting the yellow bump on the ceiling of the entrance room with the Slingshot unseals the door at the end of the hall.

evidence.quote: Run to the north end of the room and shoot the large yellow bump on the ceiling with your Slingshot.  The "door" at the end of the hall will unseal.  Go through it.

subject: Biri
text: A Biri can be stunned with a Deku Nut and then finished off with a sword strike.

evidence.quote: If a Biri gets too close, use a Deku Nut to stun it.  You actually can then kill it with your sword once it's stunned, but it's far easier to just avoid them.

subject: Pit Room East Door
text: Carrying Ruto through the east door on the lower level leads out of the Pit Room.

evidence.quote: Pick Ruto up, then leave through the east door, which should be behind you as you land from the upper level.

subject: Water Room Switch
text: Stepping on the switch in the center of the Water Room causes the water level to rise and sends Ruto back to the Pit Room if she is in the pit.

evidence.quote: Jump down into the pit, but be very careful that you don't step on the switch in the middle of the room.  The water level will rise, and Ruto (who doesn't like water... go figure) will return to the Pit Room.

subject: Stinger
text: Submerged Stingers can be forced to jump out using Deku Nuts and then killed with the Slingshot.

evidence.quote: Use Deku Nuts to make the Stingers (the submerged enemies whose fins you can see) jump up, and kill them with the Slingshot.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: A Gold Skulltula hangs on the west ivy wall of the Water Room, and raising the water level allows Link to climb up and collect its token.

evidence.quote: Once you have killed all of the Stingers, turn to the "ivy" covered wall to the west.  Kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall with the Slingshot.  Next, jump onto the switch, and the water level will rise.  Climb onto the "ivy" on the west wall, and up into the alcove, grabbing the Token on the way.

subject: Fairy
text: Destroying the pots in the west alcove of the Water Room reveals a Fairy and Slingshot Seeds.

evidence.quote: Destroy the pots in the alcove to find a Fairy and some Seeds.

subject: Water Room Ceiling Switch
text: Shooting the switch on the ceiling of the northern hallway with the Slingshot unlocks the door at the end of the hall.

evidence.quote: shoot the switch on the ceiling with your Slingshot (or you can even use Ruto to nail the switch if you're feeling sadistic.  The door at the end of the hall will unlock.  Go through it.

subject: Elevator
text: Riding the elevator while carrying Ruto brings Link to the upper level of the Pit Room.

evidence.quote: Get on the elevator, and ride it to the top of the Pit Room while carrying Ruto.

subject: Business Scrub
text: A submerged tunnel in the Elevator Room leads to a Business Scrub selling Deku Nuts.

evidence.quote: the submerged tunnel leads to a Business Scrub who sells overpriced Deku Nuts.

subject: Pit Room Upper Level
text: Crossing the upper floor of the Pit Room while avoiding Biri and floor holes leads to the opposite door.

evidence.quote: Run straight across the room to the opposite door, avoiding Biri and the pits in the floor.

subject: Yellow Switch
text: Stepping onto the yellow switch in the Crawling Hallway requires Link to be carrying Ruto to activate and unlock the door.

evidence.quote: Run to the right, and step onto the yellow switch while carrying Ruto.  Normally, your weight alone wouldn't be enough, but with Ruto's help then the switch will activate.  Go through the unlocked door in front of the switch.

subject: Boomerang
text: Defeating all the Stingers in the Stinger Room spawns a chest containing the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: this room is crawling with Stingers.  Use Deku Nuts or run in front of their paths to reveal them.  Kill them with your Slingshot.  Once they are all dead, a chest will appear.  Open it to find the Boomerang, an important weapon for Young Link.

subject: Boomerang
text: The Boomerang can be used to retrieve Gold Skulltula tokens from high and distant places.

evidence.quote: Most importantly, however, it lets you claim Skulltula Tokens from a range, finally giving you access to those troublesome Gold Skulltulas you may have seen lurking in high places.

subject: Blue Switch
text: The blue switch in the Crawling Hallway must be held down by leaving Princess Ruto on top of it to keep the door unlocked.

evidence.quote: Jump onto the switch while carrying Ruto, and it will press down.  However, if you step off the switch then it will rise again.  You'll have to leave Ruto behind on the switch, by stepping down on it, then pressing A to leave Ruto on it.  Go through the door once you've jammed the button, leaving Ruto behind.

subject: Orange Tentacle
text: Striking the narrow segment near the base of the Orange Tentacle four times with the Boomerang destroys it and removes other orange tentacles in the dungeon.

evidence.quote: Z-Target it, and use your Boomerang to attack the narrow segment near the base of the tentacle.  It will then retract into the wall.  You need to strike that segment three more times with the boomerang...Killing the Orange Tentacle will remove all of the other orange tentacles blocking passage to other areas of the dungeon.

subject: Dungeon Map
text: A chest containing the Dungeon Map appears in the room once the Orange Tentacle is defeated.

evidence.quote: A chest will appear once the Tentacle dies, open it to find the Dungeon Map.

subject: Princess Ruto
text: Speak with her when you land, and speak with her again, and she'll agree to come with you if you help her find her sacred stone in Jabu-Jabu's belly, and you now get the privilege of carrying Ruto around with you everywhere you go.

evidence.quote: Speak with her when you land, and she'll accidentally let slip that she lost a sacred stone in Jabu-Jabu's belly.  Speak with her again, and she'll agree to come with you, but only if you help her find her stone first.  You now get the privilege of carrying Ruto around with you everywhere you go.
